# AgIsoStack.VirtualTerminal

> An ISOBUS virtual terminal (ISO 11783-6) for .NET 10 on macOS, Linux, Windows, iOS and Android:
> AgIsoStack++'s VT server run on one thread, with the shown screen sent out as a JSON draw list for
> a page to paint. The host supplies CAN frames, a page, and optionally pool storage. MIT.

Implements bring their own UI (object pools), so a host designs no screens. It forwards JSON to a
page and turns touches into calls. Package `AgIsoStack.VirtualTerminal`, namespace `AgIsoStack`.

Rules an integration must keep:

- One `VirtualTerminal` per process. Call `Start()` before the link, and stop the link before `Stop()`.
- Every event and every `IPoolStore` call comes on the terminal's own thread. Marshal to the UI with
  a non-blocking post (BeginInvoke, Post); never a synchronous Invoke or `.Wait()` from a handler.
  Keep handlers short: the bus waits on them.
- Calls (`SoftKeyAsync`, `ButtonAsync`, `SelectAsync`, `SetNumberAsync`, `SetStringAsync`,
  `EscapeAsync`, `ActivateAsync`) work from any thread and return tasks. They fail with
  `InvalidOperationException` when the terminal isn't running.
- `Send` (in options) runs on the terminal's thread and its span is valid only during the call:
  copy it, queue it, return. `Receive` and `AowLink.Send` work from any thread.
- Every key or button press must end in `Released` or `Aborted`. While a key is down the host
  sends `Held` about every 200 ms (the terminal doesn't repeat by itself).
- Input numbers are raw: shown = (raw + offset) * scale. `SetNumberAsync` takes raw, within min..max.
- Drive the field editor from `edit` messages (`"o": null` closes it), not from your own calls.
- Keep pictures from the `Image` event for the life of the terminal; screens refer to them by id.
- Don't give it a store that refuses to save: implements told "not stored" disconnect. The
  default store keeps pools in memory; `FilePoolStore` keeps them on disk.
- Subscribe to `HandlerFailed`: exceptions in handlers and stores go there, not to the caller.

Minimal host:

```csharp
var link = new AowLink(gatewayHost, name: "My terminal");
var vt = new VirtualTerminal(new VirtualTerminalOptions { Send = link.Send, Store = new FilePoolStore(poolDir) });
vt.Attach(link);
vt.Message += json => page.Post(json);   // screen, edit, workingSets, alarms, audio, volume
vt.Image += image => page.PostImage(image);
vt.HandlerFailed += e => log(e);
vt.Start();
link.Start();
```
